title: Topology and dynamics of unimodular random hyperbolic manifolds
summary: We investigate the relationship between the space of ends of a unimodular random hyperbolic manifold and the dynamics of its geodesic flow. We show that having two ends of infinite volume implies recurrence, while having infinitely many such ends implies positive drift and entropy. We also provide a transience criterion which applies to deterministic hyperbolic manifolds. Our method relies on studying Delaunay graphs over point processes and on the analytic notion of capacity.
